lines.trans: Hear how naturally the second half flows from the first half, Hao?
You cannot even tell where thirty years ago ends and today begins.
And not one squeak on middle D—Chen earned two slices of lemon tart!
Raise your teacups, boys: to Room Nine, and to our saved courtyard!
To chef Mei, who directed an entire cafe kitchen from two pillows!
By Friday evening your ankle will be ready to stand and greet every regular on the street.
Wait—look past the courtyard tree toward the open street gate, Hao!
An older gentleman in a grey hat stopped right outside on the pavement.
He took his hat off when the piano reached the second page...
Wait a second—he is humming the exact melody along with Teacher Song!
How could a stranger on the street know an unpublished waltz from a locked room?!
Call Qing to the front gate right now—don't let him walk away!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.en: completely identical; cast from the same mold
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì mú yí yàng. Note second-tone mú here ('one mold, one look').

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng yāng. Compound 中 ('middle') + 央 ('center'); also used in music for the middle register (中央八度 'middle octave').

examples.text: 院子中央摆着一张干净的木头圆桌。
examples.trans: A clean round wooden table stands in the center of the courtyard.

examples.text: 请把手放在钢琴键盘的中央。
examples.trans: Please place your hands at the center of the piano keyboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ chú. Combines 主 ('chief/head') + 厨 ('cook/kitchen'); measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 小美主厨坐在两个枕头上，用木勺指挥整个厨房。
examples.trans: Head Chef Mei sat propped on two pillows, directing the whole kitchen with a wooden spoon.

examples.text: 这位年轻的主厨最擅长烤酥脆的杏仁柠檬挞。
examples.trans: This young head chef specializes in baking crisp almond lemon tarts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǔ qǐ. Resultative verb compound 举 ('lift/hold aloft') + 起 ('upward'), used for raising a teacup in a toast or lifting one's hand.

examples.text: 大家都举起热茶杯，一起敬重获新生的九号房。
examples.trans: Everyone raised their warm teacups in a toast to the newly restored Room Nine.

examples.text: 小美举起手里的木勺，像乐队指挥一样轻轻敲了两下。
examples.trans: Mei lifted the wooden spoon in her hand and tapped twice like an orchestra conductor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rén xíng dào. Compound 人 ('pedestrian') + 行 ('walk') + 道 ('way/path'); measure word: 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 一位戴灰帽子的老先生正好停在门外的人行道上。
examples.trans: An older gentleman in a grey hat stopped right on the pavement outside the gate.

examples.text: 秋天的梧桐叶落在窄窄的人行道上，踩上去沙沙作响。
examples.trans: Autumn plane-tree leaves fall along the narrow sidewalk and rustle underfoot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天一天 ('all day today').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: men. Attaches to pronouns (我们, 你们, 他们) and human nouns (孩子们).

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 我梦寐以求的咖啡馆，就开在自家庭院里！等着瞧我去告诉整条街的人吧！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 我父亲答应不再和那个女人联系，才保住了他们的婚姻，但他确实是我的亲弟弟。
examples.trans: My father promised never to contact that woman again to save their marriage, yet the boy is truly my half-brother.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí de. Followed by a noun, score, or action worth the effort.

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 这家安静的小客栈很值得再来。
examples.trans: This quiet boutique inn is well worth visiting again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tíng. Used for vehicles pulling up, rain stopping, or pausing an action.

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān sheng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位先生 ('a gentleman').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū. Core directional verb meaning 'outward'.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn. Counts clock minutes (五分), test/review points (十分), and currency cents.

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

前半段.gloss: first half (of a piece, journey, or text)

meanings.en: first half (of a piece, journey, or text)
meanings.note: Pinyin: qián bàn duàn. Combines 前 ('front/first') + 半 ('half') + 段 ('section/passage'); contrasts with 后半段 ('second half').

examples.text: 后半段旋律接上三十年前的前半段，流淌得非常自然。
examples.trans: The second half of the melody joins the thirty-year-old first half and flows so naturally.

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲的前半段轻快明亮，后半段温暖柔和。
examples.trans: The first half of this waltz is bright and lively, while the second half is warm and gentle.

meanings.en: by all means; be sure (not) to
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān wàn. Strong, caring emphasis before 别 or 要 (千万别忘 'whatever you do, don't forget').

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

examples.text: 小美，千万别因为我们多忙活。
examples.trans: Mei, please do not go to extra trouble on our account.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chú fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间厨房 ('a kitchen').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā biǎo. Combines 发 ('issue/put forth') + 表 ('make known publicly'), used for publishing musical works, articles, or speeches.

examples.text: 街上的陌生人怎么会知道这首从来没发表过的圆舞曲呢？
examples.trans: How could a stranger on the street know this waltz that was never published?

examples.text: 宋老师年轻时在音乐杂志上发表过好几首钢琴小品。
examples.trans: When Teacher Song was young, she published several short piano pieces in music magazines.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Introduces a person's given or full name (我叫小晴 'My name is Xiaoqing') or calls a cab.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

后半段.gloss: second half (of a song, road, or event)

meanings.en: second half (of a song, road, or event)
meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu bàn duàn. Combines 后 ('back/latter') + 半 ('half') + 段 ('section/stretch').

examples.text: 这首曲子的后半段比开头更温柔。
examples.trans: The second half of this piece is gentler than the opening.

examples.text: 电影的后半段让大家都看入迷了。
examples.trans: The second half of the film captivated everyone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi guǎn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家咖啡馆 ('a café').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎr. Spoken northern/standard variant of 哪里 ('where').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēng. Read 1st-tone hēng when softly humming a tune under one's breath (哼歌 'hum a song').

examples.text: 小美一边揉面团，一边轻轻哼着歌。
examples.trans: Mei softly hummed a tune while kneading bread dough.

examples.text: 宋老师看着旧乐谱，小声哼出了第一句。
examples.trans: Looking at the old score, Teacher Song softly hummed the opening phrase.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán wǔ qǔ. Compound from 圆 ('circle') + 舞 ('dance') + 曲 ('musical piece'). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上弹了一首轻快的圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played a lively waltz on the piano.

examples.text: 这首老圆舞曲让人想起三十年前的晚茶会。
examples.trans: This old waltz brings back memories of evening tea gatherings thirty years ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Means both 'sit down' (请坐) and 'ride inside a vehicle' (坐火车 'take the train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个外面 ('an outside area').

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 门外站着一位拿箱子的客人。
examples.trans: A guest holding a suitcase is standing outside the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō. Means 'many' as an adjective, 'how…?' before adjectives (多大), or 'more than' after round numbers (三十多).

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén kǒu. Location noun built from 大门 ('main gate') + 口 ('entranceway').

examples.text: 送货车停在客栈大门口等我们签字。
examples.trans: The delivery van parked at the inn's front gate waiting for us to sign.

examples.text: 大门口的两盆绿植物刚浇过水。
examples.trans: The two pots of green plants by the main gate were just watered.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán quán. Emphasizes 100% agreement or completeness (完全正确 'completely right').

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo huǒ zi. Affectionate everyday term for an energetic young man; takes plural suffix 们 when addressing a group directly; measure word: 个 (gè) or 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 小美笑着对志鹏和志豪说：“小伙子们，举起茶杯吧！”
examples.trans: Mei smiled at Peng and Hao and said, 'Boys, raise your teacups!'

examples.text: 那两个年轻的小伙子一个早上就把厨房的面团和浓汤都准备好了。
examples.trans: Those two young fellows got both the bread dough and the rich soup ready in a single morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mào zi. Combines 帽 ('headgear/hat') + noun suffix 子; measure word: 顶 (dǐng); verb for wearing: 戴 (dài).

examples.text: 钢琴弹到第二页的时候，门外的老先生把灰帽子摘下来了。
examples.trans: When the piano reached page two, the older gentleman outside the gate took off his grey hat.

examples.text: 太阳大的时候，老陈在院子里干活总戴着一顶草帽子。
examples.trans: When the sun is strong, Chen always wears a straw hat while working in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi shǐ. Everyday verb for starting work, breakfast, or a lesson.

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán. Used for playing the piano or guitar (弹钢琴 'play the piano').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Specifically for accessories placed on the head, face, neck, or wrist—contrast 穿 for clothes/shoes.

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng jiān. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房间 ('a room').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Verb/noun zhǐhuī ('command, direct').

examples.text: 今晚您还是待在中控室里进行指挥吧。
examples.trans: Tonight you should stay in the control room to direct.

examples.text: 导演在现场指挥摄像。
examples.trans: The director commands the cameras on set.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Used for answering calls (接电话), meeting someone at a station, or catching drips.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
examples.trans: Hao set it down casually when he took the dry towel!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāi. Used for picking herbs, fruit, or flowers, and also for taking off glasses or hats.

examples.text: 这碗番茄汤里放了刚从院子里摘的新鲜香草。
examples.trans: This bowl of tomato soup has fresh herbs just picked from the courtyard.

examples.text: 宋老师摘下眼镜，轻轻合上了那本旧登记本。
examples.trans: Teacher Song took off her glasses and gently closed the old guest book.

meanings.en: throw wide open; leave wide open
meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎng kāi. Describes gates or windows opened wide.

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 每天早上八点，小院木门准时敞开。
examples.trans: Every morning at eight, the wooden courtyard gates swing wide open.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìng. Used when raising a teacup or glass in honor of someone (敬你一杯 'toast you a cup').

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 我以热茶代酒，敬您一杯。
examples.trans: With hot tea in place of wine, I raise a cup to you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng gè. Combines 整 ('whole') + 个; modifies singular nouns directly without another measure word (整个中央八度).

examples.text: 修好那根琴槌以后，宋老师给整个中央八度调了音。
examples.trans: After fixing that hammer, Teacher Song tuned the entire middle octave.

examples.text: 柠檬挞的香味飘满了整个咖啡角。
examples.trans: The aroma of lemon tart drifted through the entire café corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuán lǜ. Musical melody or tune. Measure word: 段 (duàn, 'passage/melody').

examples.text: 这段钢琴旋律听起来既温柔又熟悉。
examples.trans: This piano melody sounds both gentle and familiar.

examples.text: 哪怕过了很多年，我还是记得那首歌的旋律。
examples.trans: Even after many years, I still remember the melody of that song.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个晚上 ('an evening').

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zá yīn. Combines 杂 ('mixed/stray') + 音 ('sound'): mechanical buzz, rattle, or static interfering with pure musical tone.

examples.text: 老陈修好琴槌以后，中央瑞音一点儿杂音都没有了。
examples.trans: After Chen repaired the piano hammer, middle D had not the slightest squeak or buzz.

examples.text: 关上朝马路的那扇小窗，屋里就听不见外面的杂音了。
examples.trans: Close that small window facing the main road and you won't hear any stray noise inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěn tou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个枕头 ('a pillow').

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng tà. Combines 柠檬 ('lemon') + 挞 ('tart', phonetic loan from English 'tart').

examples.text: 星期二我们要修好琴键，还要烤星期三的柠檬挞！
examples.trans: On Tuesday we will fix the piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!

examples.text: 酸甜清香的杏仁柠檬挞成了咖啡角的招牌甜点。
examples.trans: Sweet-tart, fragrant almond lemon tart became the café corner's signature dessert.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng zài. Placed before a verb to mark an action happening at this very moment.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú tǎng. Coordinate verb 流 ('flow') + 淌 ('stream/trickle'), used both for water and for music or time flowing effortlessly.

examples.text: 你听这首圆舞曲的后半段接上前半段，流淌得多自然呀！
examples.trans: Listen to how naturally the second half of the waltz flows right out of the first half!

examples.text: 温柔的钢琴声像清澈的溪水一样在阳光房里静静流淌。
examples.trans: Gentle piano music flowed quietly through the sunroom like a clear stream.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī. Stative colour adjective ('grey'); also used as a noun for dust/ash.

examples.text: 我每天走过那几扇灰窗板，竟然都没注意到它们。
examples.trans: I walked past those grey shutters every day and stopped noticing them.

examples.text: 这些干燥的灰木头明天刷上暖绿油漆就漂亮了。
examples.trans: Once this dry grey wood gets brushed with warm green paint tomorrow, it will look lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎnr. Colloquial erhua form of 一点 after adjectives and imperatives (小心点儿 'be a bit careful', 快点儿 'hurry a bit').

examples.text: 你们两个站在梯子上小心点儿！
examples.trans: Be careful up there on the ladder, you two!

examples.text: 夜里石板路有点滑，走的时候慢点儿。
examples.trans: The stone path is a bit slippery at night; walk a little slower.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shú rén. Combines 熟 ('familiar/well-known') + 人 ('person'); 老熟人 means an old friend or longtime neighbourhood regular.

examples.text: 到星期五晚上，小美就能站起来迎接街上的每一位老熟人了。
examples.trans: By Friday evening, Mei will be able to stand up and greet every longtime regular from the street.

examples.text: 在梧桐巷住了十年，老陈走在街上到处都能遇见熟人。
examples.trans: Having lived on Wutong Lane for ten years, Chen runs into familiar faces everywhere he walks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ruì yīn. Combines Chinese solfège 瑞 (ruì, 'Re / D') + 音 ('musical note').

examples.text: 第二十八小节的旋律正好稳稳落在中央瑞音上！
examples.trans: The melody in bar twenty-eight lands squarely on middle D!

examples.text: 修好轴销以后，中央瑞音终于重新发出了清脆的声音。
examples.trans: Once the hinge pin was fixed, middle D finally rang out clearly again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

知道.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.en: know (a fact or piece of information)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī dào. Contrast 认识 ('know a person or place').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

examples.text: 这是第二啊。
examples.trans: This is second.

examples.text: 那个第二好。
examples.trans: That second is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ér qiě. Adds a further supporting point.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo huái. Combines 脚 ('foot') + 踝 ('ankle joint'); measure word: 只 (zhī) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 志鹏关心地问：“小美，今天早上你的脚踝感觉怎么样？”
examples.trans: Peng asked warmly, 'Mei, how does your ankle feel this morning?'

examples.text: 休息了一天半以后，小美扭伤的脚踝已经消肿，到星期五就能站起来了。
examples.trans: After a day and a half of rest, Mei's sprained ankle has gone down in swelling and she will be able to stand by Friday.

meanings.note: Adverb/adjective zìrán ('naturally, of its own accord').

examples.text: 不理它，谣言自然就过去了。
examples.trans: Ignore it, and the rumour will naturally pass.

examples.text: 她在镜头前表现得很自然。
examples.trans: She acts very naturally in front of the camera.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá bēi. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只茶杯 ('a teacup').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
examples.trans: And the teacup inside? Is it still intact?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条街 ('a street').

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shang. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 整条街上 ('along the street').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Verb yuèguò ('cross over, bypass').

examples.text: 他们两个越过那边直接来接触咱们了。
examples.trans: The two of them bypassed the other side to contact us directly.

examples.text: 汇报工作请按流程来，不要随便越过主管。
examples.trans: Follow workflow when reporting instead of bypassing your lead.

meanings.en: to work under; to shadow or apprentice with
meanings.note: gēnzhe — 跟 + durative aspect particle 着; idiomatic in professional settings for working on a mentor's or boss's team
indicates accompanying someone physically or acting immediately in sequence

examples.text: 跟着我，肯定是上十二歌王了。
examples.trans: Working under me, it will definitely be on Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
examples.trans: For the next few days, shadow Sister Xingzi and lend her a hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng jiē. Used for stepping out to greet an arriving guest.

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà biān. Points to a location or party on the other end.

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: suǒ. Works as both verb ('lock the door' 锁门) and noun ('a lock' 一把锁).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇门 ('a door').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
examples.trans: Here is the small silver key to the third-floor attic door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shēng rén. Combines 陌生 ('unfamiliar/strange') + 人 ('person'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 街上的陌生人怎么会知道锁在房间里三十年没发表过的圆舞曲呢？
examples.trans: How could a stranger on the street know a waltz that was locked away unpublished in a room for thirty years?

examples.text: 走进九号房喝过一杯热茶以后，陌生人也很快变成了老朋友。
examples.trans: After stepping into Room Nine and sharing a cup of hot tea, even strangers quickly become old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè. Counts pages directly without 个 (第二页 'page two').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!
